prompt: Use $apple-hig to help with this task: Review the premium recipe purchase flow before implementation. Read interface.md. Audit the supplied interface; rank verified findings and show corrected behavior. Write result.md with decisions, a worked before/after, acceptance checks, and evidence limits. Use a framework-agnostic specification or pseudocode; do not assume an Apple SDK is available.

input_files.interface.md: Platform: iOS. Paywall says Free Trial but omits renewal price and period. Restore purchases is absent. The locked recipe button looks like a one-time purchase yet starts an annual subscription. Dismissing the paywall removes saved free recipes. Signup has no Terms or Privacy links.

criteria.task_completion: Provide truthful product and subscription choices, visible price/terms and restoration path, preserve free content and cancellation; do not offer legal/App Review approval or assert payment processing success.
criteria.hig_correctness: Apply the apple-in-app-purchase guidance to the actual supplied decisions, preserving its platform and contextual qualifications.
criteria.artifact_usefulness: Provide implementable states, labels, transitions or layout decisions for this specific fixture, with a concrete before/after and observable checks. Provide truthful product and subscription choices, visible price/terms and restoration path, preserve free content and cancellation; do not offer legal/App Review approval or assert payment processing success.
criteria.conditions_accessibility: Retain the stated platform/input constraints. Address accessible alternatives and exceptional states relevant to this task. Provide truthful product and subscription choices, visible price/terms and restoration path, preserve free content and cancellation; do not offer legal/App Review approval or assert payment processing success.
criteria.evidence_honesty: Distinguish source-backed guidance, product assumptions and proposed checks. Do not invent device, SDK, accessibility, visual, performance or user-test results.

critical_errors: Invents observations or claims Apple-device execution absent supplied evidence.
Recommends a topic-specific behavior contrary to the supplied source without explaining the scope and tradeoff.

required_findings.description: Trial omits standard renewal price and period.
One-time-looking recipe choice actually initiates an annual subscription.
Dismissing purchase removes already available free content.
Signup omits required Terms and Privacy links.

rubric.review_threshold: Find at least four of five seeded defects, including every critical defect; no invented high-severity finding.
